title: onopordum illyricum subsp. horridum
intro: Onopordum illyricum subsp. horridum, commonly known as the thistle of the Balkans, is a perennial plant species belonging to the sunflower family (Asteraceae). This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Onopordum illyricum subsp. horridum include pain relief, wound healing, and the treatment of various infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
